declaration: Manual scenarios fixed before examining new outputs; no optimization, ranking or experimental gain claim.

scenarios.description: Hypothetical 0.5 mOhm on every segment of both rails; feasibility and actual resistance unverified
Manually reduce requested current to 12 A for the same 360 s; reduced service must be reported

sensitivity_application: Each of the seven changes separately on all four main scenarios. No joint distribution or combination of independent errors is assumed.
coordinate_check_application: Equal-SOC baseline only. Shift SOC and reference coordinates together; this is relabelling, not an extra uncertainty scenario.
time_step_application: All four main scenarios; compare terminal voltage, branch currents, SOC and integrated energy against 0.25 s.
assessment_policy: No unused characterization cells or protected module outcomes may be opened. Only existing model artifacts and the four already-used cells' C/20 curves are needed.
